core_obligations: The characteristic function (proof lines 917-924): for each subset B of A define chi_B : A -> 2 by chi_B(x) = 1 if x in B and 0 otherwise.
The bijection (lines 925-928): f(B) = chi_B defines a bijection f : Pow(A) -> (A -> 2), so Pow(A) is equinumerous with the function set (A -> 2).
Conclusion (lines 929-931): hence |Pow(A)| = |(|A| -> 2)| = 2^{|A|}, since replacing A by any equinumerous set does not change the cardinality of the function set.
proof_roadmap: Map each subset to its characteristic function.
Verify this gives a bijection onto the function set (A -> 2).
difficulty_reason: Cardinal arithmetic lemma (statement 913-915, proof 917-931): the power set of A has cardinality 2^{|A|} - the proof is the standard characteristic-function bijection, complete in three short steps; no verification is omitted. H2: standard bijection argument.
